meta.name: upgrade-claude
meta.description: Upgrade Claude Code to the latest version with graceful shutdown and auto-restart. Use when the user asks to upgrade or when a new Claude Code version is available.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动升级 Claude Code 并优雅重启
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要手动升级 Claude Code 并希望自动完成
copy.tagline_en: Automatically upgrade Claude Code with graceful restart
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often manually upgrade Claude Code and want it automated

howto.what: 装上后，当你要升级 Claude Code 时，它会自动执行退出、升级和重启流程，确保升级过程中不会丢失工作进度。
howto.when: 当你明确要求升级 Claude Code，或者检测到新版本可用时触发。

say.text: 帮我升级 Claude Code 到最新版本。
say.note: 技能会执行退出、升级、重启流程。

say.text: 检查 Claude Code 是否有更新，有的话就升级。
say.note: 技能会先检查版本，再决定是否升级。

howto.what_en: When you ask to upgrade Claude Code, it gracefully shuts down, upgrades, and restarts, preserving your work context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask to upgrade Claude Code or when a new version is detected.

say_en.text: Upgrade Claude Code to the latest version.
say_en.note: Skill will exit, upgrade, and restart.

say_en.text: Check for Claude Code updates and upgrade if available.
say_en.note: Skill checks version first, then upgrades if needed.
